get.description: Open with a WebSocket upgrade; browsers cannot set headers on a WebSocket, so the JWT goes in `token`. The server sends JSON text frames, each a `LiveMessage`: first one `LiveSnapshot` with the Run and its steps so far, then a `LiveStepMessage` as each step starts or finishes and a `LiveStatus` when the Run's status changes. It closes after the final status. Close codes: 4401 bad token, 4404 not this user's Run.
